rv.q: This is one weird deconstruction of a play.
This staging feels both physically claustrophobic and intellectually expansive.
You might even leave the theater puzzled about your experience.
Attempts on Her Life is a visually appealing and interesting show that comes across as avant-garde and unusual.

cn.t: TUTA's return with Crimp's experimental work earns respect for its ambition and technical craft, but critics find the plotless, abstract structure challenging and difficult to connect with emotionally.
